name: cdm/event/workflow/MessageInformation
description: This class corresponds to the components of the FpML MessageHeader.model.

copyTo.description: A unique identifier (within the specified coding scheme) giving the details of some party to whom a copy of this message will be sent for reference.

messageId.description: A unique identifier assigned to the message.

sentBy.description: The identifier for the originator of a message instance.

sentTo.description: The identifier(s) for the recipient(s) of a message instance.
